title: Financial advisors and providers expats can contact
intro: These providers can help users move from research to a real financial planning conversation: expat-focused planners, wealth managers, cross-border support and banking pathways. Treat this as a discovery list, not a ranking or recommendation.

items.reason: Expat-focused financial planning for internationally mobile professionals — useful when pensions, investments and cross-border complexity need structured planning.
Wealth management and financial planning for international clients; useful for retirement, investment structure and ongoing advisory relationships.
Independent financial advice provider; useful for expats comparing planning-only conversations around pensions, investments and household goals.
Wealth planning organisation with English-language materials; useful for retirement projections, investments and estate planning discussions.
Dedicated expat positioning around investment and financial planning; useful when English-first guidance is a priority.
Wealth management for international professionals and entrepreneurs; useful for higher-complexity investment and cross-border files.
Partner option for low-cost international transfers and multi-currency accounts — often relevant when planning spans more than one country.
Cross-border tax and accountancy support when financial planning questions overlap with returns, payroll or entrepreneur income.
Partner bank with wealth-management and private-banking pathways; useful as a bank-side comparison alongside independent planners.
Partner bank useful for comparing banking, savings and investment account context alongside advisory support.

disclosure: Some links may be affiliate or referral links. If you use them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Ordering reflects relevance to expat financial-advisor discovery, not pay-to-rank placement. This is not investment, tax, pension or financial advice; verify AFM registration where relevant and confirm fees, scope, credentials and terms directly with licensed advisers and providers.
